intent: Implement R2dbcAuditTrail (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing AuditTrail with the non-blocking Spring DatabaseClient: inserts one row into append-only table audit_trail (columns actor, action = enum name, outcome, occurred_at = UTC LocalDateTime of the entry timestamp, correlation_id; id is database-generated). Never updates or deletes. Failures surface as error signals. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration (no stereotype annotation).
